author: Stan Horwitz
text: Contact Abbott customer support. Sounds like a faulty sensor.

author: Steve Kuckuk
text: It depends on the type of error. For example, “loss of signal“ is generally easily resolved, other errors may or may not be resolved. Generally next to the error message there is a circle with an "I" in the center, this icon means “information” so if you press that icon, it will give you more specific information.
